svg.title: Copilot IoT Game — Microsoft cloud architecture
svg.desc: Transparent 85 by 196 millimetre overlay for the RP09 left design plate. Panel telemetry flows from Azure IoT Hub to Event Hubs and Azure Functions, then to SignalR and Power Pages, Dataverse and Power Apps, and Copilot Studio.
